producing_agent.identity: Cursor Grok 4.6 (cloud agent, under J. Brown direction)

hypothesis: On X = {0,1}^4 with orbit-canonical screens q_G, exact representability of a task Y occurs iff model symmetry is contained in target symmetry (G_M ⊆ G_Y). Under-repair (G_M notsubseteq G_Y) makes Y unrepresentable: Y is not constant on q-fibres. Over-repair (G_M a proper subset of G_Y) remains representable but has strictly more fibres (leftover privilege / shortcut surface). Exact repair of a mixed fibre must split leftover Y-disagreement. Delete-then-default and relative-then-drop do not commute. A 4-cycle of integer steps closes iff the steps sum to 0, and two potentials for the same steps differ by a constant.

gates.DTA_NOGO: Every (model, task) with G_M notsubseteq G_Y is unrepresentable: Y is not constant on the fibres of q_M. Checked on {q_id, q_rot, q_perm, q_stab0} × {bag, necklace, first_bit, identity}.
gates.DTA_SAFE: Every (model, task) with G_M ⊆ G_Y is representable: Y is constant on the fibres of q_M. Same 4×4 grid. Includes leftover privilege (finer screens still factor).
gates.DTA_OVERREPAIR_COST: On popcount/bag, q_id has strictly more fibres than q_perm. Recorded fibre counts must be 16 vs 5. This is a cost, not a no-go.
gates.DTA_MINIMAL_SAFE: For first_bit, the Stab(0) orbit map is representable and q_perm is not. G_rot ∩ G_first equals {e} (the only rotation that fixes index 0 is the identity), so q_rot is not representable for first_bit.
gates.DTA_REPAIR_DEBT: On first_bit, at least one q_perm fibre mixes first-bit values. For r = first_bit, ExactRepair holds and every leftover Y-disagreement on a q_perm fibre is already an r-disagreement. A constant dummy r is not an exact repair.
gates.DTA_NONCOMMUTE: Path A (drop index 0, write default 0) and Path B (remember x[1]-x[0] as int, drop the absolute) disagree: there exist two states that agree on Path A and disagree on Path B. The Lean pair witness (0,1) vs (1,1) is included as a regression.
gates.DTA_POSITIONAL_HOLONOMY: On a 4-cycle of Int steps, the prefix potential returns to 0 iff the steps sum to 0. A declared zero-sum cycle closes and a declared nonzero-sum cycle does not. Two potentials for the same steps differ by the constant p(0)-q(0).

kill_criteria.DTA_NOGO: Kill if any enumerated (G_M, Y) with G_M notsubseteq G_Y has Y constant on q_M-fibres.
kill_criteria.DTA_SAFE: Kill if any enumerated (G_M, Y) with G_M ⊆ G_Y has Y non-constant on a q_M-fibre.
kill_criteria.DTA_OVERREPAIR_COST: Kill if n_fibres(q_id) is not 16, or n_fibres(q_perm) is not 5, or n_fibres(q_id) ≤ n_fibres(q_perm) on the popcount task.
kill_criteria.DTA_MINIMAL_SAFE: Kill if q_stab0 fails first_bit, or q_perm represents first_bit, or q_rot represents first_bit, or G_rot ∩ G_first is not exactly {e}.
kill_criteria.DTA_REPAIR_DEBT: Kill if no q_perm fibre mixes first-bit values, or r=first_bit fails ExactRepair / the split property, or a constant r is accepted as an exact repair.
kill_criteria.DTA_NONCOMMUTE: Kill if no pair of states (or the Lean (0,1)/(1,1) pair) agrees on Path A and disagrees on Path B.
kill_criteria.DTA_POSITIONAL_HOLONOMY: Kill if the zero-sum 4-cycle fails to close, the nonzero-sum 4-cycle closes, closing fails to match sum==0, or two potentials for the same steps differ by a non-constant.

groups.G_stab0: stabilizer of index 0 inside S_4 (6 permutations)

audit_card.target_object: Orbit-canonical screens q_G and task maps Y on the 16-point cube {0,1}^4, together with the delete/repair schedules and a 4-cycle of integer steps.
audit_card.decision: Accept or reject the finite symmetry-matching biconditional (representable iff G_M ⊆ G_Y), the leftover-privilege fibre-count cost, the mixed-fibre split obligation, Path-A/Path-B noncommutativity, and cycle holonomy / potential uniqueness.
audit_card.representation: Binary 4-tuples; permutations as source-index 4-tuples with (g·x)_i = x[perm[i]]; exact Python ints; no floats.
audit_card.data_clock: None. Closed finite world, no sampling, no time series, no held-out split.
material_assumptions: The listed groups act by permuting positions; q_G is the lex-least orbit representative (for bits, sorted tuple = popcount fibres).
G_Y is the pointwise stabilizer of Y inside S_4, computed by enumeration, not assumed from a formula except as a regression target.
Representability is fibre-constancy of Y, not approximate reconstruction or statistical risk.
Path A/B and holonomy are the Lean DeleteRepair constructions transported to sequences / Int lists; they are finite algebraic facts, not a relativity theorem.

objects.S_4: permutations of {0,1,2,3} acting by position rearrangement
objects.q_G: orbit-canonical map X → X, lex-least G-orbit representative
objects.G_Y: {g in S_4 : Y(g x) = Y(x) for all x in X}

mathematical_claim.types_domains_units: All values are exact integers or integer tuples. No units. Support is the entire cube.
mathematical_claim.exact_claim: For every G in {G_id, G_rot, G_perm, G_stab0} and every Y in {bag, necklace, first_bit, identity}, Y is constant on q_G-fibres if and only if G ⊆ G_Y. Separately: n_fibres(q_id)=16 > n_fibres(q_perm)=5 on bag; Stab(0) is safe for first_bit and S_4 is not; G_rot ∩ G_first = {e}; some q_perm fibre mixes first_bit and r=first_bit splits it; Path A and Path B disagree; prefix potential of a 4-cycle returns to 0 iff the step sum is 0; two potentials differ by a constant.
mathematical_claim.quantifiers: Universal over the listed finite G and Y; existential for the mixed fibre, the noncommute pair, and the two holonomy cycles.
mathematical_claim.assumptions: Left action by position permutation; orbit-canonical screens; G_Y computed inside S_4; exact equality, not risk.
mathematical_claim.identification_conditions: Fibre-constancy is the identification of Y from q. No statistical identification.
mathematical_claim.derivation_dependencies: Lean DeleteRepair: symmetry_mismatch_nogo, invariant_orbits_factor, identity_always_factors, repair_splits_disagreement, repair_paths_disagree, cycle_integrates_iff_sum_zero, potentials_unique_up_to_translation. CommonSuffScreen contrapositive packaged as a group action; not a new logical primitive.
mathematical_claim.coordinate_invariance: Orbit maps are lex-least representatives (a gauge fix). Representability is representative-independent because it is a statement about fibres. Holonomy uniqueness is up to a global translation of the potential.
mathematical_claim.edge_limiting_null_cases: G={e} always represents (identity screen). G=S_4 represents only S_4-invariant tasks (bag). Empty mixed-fibre would kill repair debt. Zero steps close; a nonzero constant step field does not. Two equal potentials differ by 0.

compute.sampling: exact enumeration of 16 worlds, 24 permutations, 4 models × 4 tasks, and two declared 4-cycles. No PRNG.

claim_boundary: Accepted only as a finite exact regression of the listed DeleteRepair facts on n=4 binary sequences. Not a general proof for arbitrary n or groups. Not Shannon entropy. Not a relativity theorem. Over-repair is leftover privilege, not an obstruction.
